    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)

    if not np.any(fit):

    is_empty = np.isclose(bins, max_cap) & np.isclose(rem, max_cap - item)
    
    original_cap = np.where(is_empty, max_cap, bins + item)

        [utilization >= 0.85, utilization >= 0.60],

    scores[fit] = harmonic_fit[fit] + tier_bonus[fit]
    scores[fit & is_empty] -= 0.75
